potential_user_journeys.scenario_description: Admin searches for a user and manages their permissions or deletes their account.

steps.element_description: Search input field to find users by name or ID.
Apply button to filter the search results.
Remove Admin button for the selected user.

expected_outcome: The user list is filtered to show relevant users based on the search criteria.
The user's admin privileges are successfully removed.

potential_user_journeys.scenario_description: Admin navigates to add a new user to the system.

steps.element_description: Add Roosters button to initiate adding a new user.
Fill out the user details form.
Submit button to finalize adding the user.

expected_outcome: A new user is successfully added to the system.

potential_user_journeys.scenario_description: Users can view and manage existing connectors, including editing and deleting them.

steps.element_description: The 'Edit' button next to a connector.
Modify the connector details in the displayed form.

expected_outcome: The connector details are updated and visible in the list.

potential_user_journeys.scenario_description: Users can add new connectors to integrate additional services or tools.

steps.element_description: Fill in the connector name and type in the provided form.
The 'Save' button to add the connector.

expected_outcome: A new connector is successfully added and displayed in the list.

potential_user_journeys.scenario_description: A user filters test suites by a specific criteria to find relevant tests.

steps.element_description: Filter button located near test suites table.
Enter filter criteria in the search box.
Verify relevant test suites are displayed.

expected_outcome: Filtered test suites matching criteria are displayed.

potential_user_journeys.scenario_description: A user creates a new test suite for a specific AI model and test type.

steps.element_description: Fill out test suite details in the form.
Submit button to save the test suite.

expected_outcome: Test suite appears in the list with the provided details.
